description: Radar stories of the last 48 hours: the same event at different outlets is matched by shared word stems, each outlet's headline is labelled by the Searle speech-act word rules, and Krippendorff's alpha measures agreement beyond chance. Verdicts collecting, outlets_agree, partly_agree, status_disputed, with examples of events presented differently. Agreement is not truth. Rule-based, no AI. In honour of Klaus Krippendorff (1932-2022), author of the alpha reliability coefficient.
name: get_krippendorff
title: Krippendorff sensor: do outlets present the same event the same way (event, statement, promise, threat, demand)
